summary: Materialise NV, a Belgian 3D printing software and services firm listed on Nasdaq and Euronext, filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release dated September 7, 2026, disclosing weekly progress under its share buy-back program announced on October 30, 2025. The program authorizes repurchases up to EUR 30 million through a discretionary mandate granted to an independent financial intermediary. During August 31–September 4, 2026, Materialise repurchased 73,335 shares on Nasdaq at an average price of EUR 6.18 per share, totaling EUR 453,314 (USD 525,823). Since the program began on January 26, 2026, the company has bought back 1,279,715 shares (2.2% of outstanding) for EUR 6,446,397 (USD 7,532,366). All purchases occurred through the central order book, with no cross or block trades. Materialise holds 1,279,715 treasury shares. Disclosure follows Belgian Royal Decree Article 8:4. Weekly updates are posted on the company's investor relations website; watch for continued buyback pace and execution against the EUR 30 million authorization, with ~EUR 23.6 million remaining, potentially supporting share price.
